about_the_game:
Steady your blade - and spin!

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Something faster, with numbers, fights and goblins!

The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS, a strange little blend of slot machine and fantasy RPG. 

To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hiphop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go “PLING PLING PLING” as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.

The features of this game are: 

  • Fun slot machine

  • Weird fantasy world

  • Crude drawings of strange little guys

  • Retro visuals

  • Crunchy hip hop drum machines

  • Addictive arcade gameplay that goes “pling” a lot

  • Numbers! Fights! Goblins!

As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is made by a solo developer and doesn’t offer 80+ hours of content like games developed by bigger teams. 


What to expect in the demo

The demo itself will just be a taster of what’s to come in the main game, so you’ll be able to play through the first two zones, and play around with a relatively limited set of weapons, abilities, upgrades and modifiers for now, but there should be enough to get a good sense of what the game’s about. The main game will obviously have tons more enemies to fight and stuff to unlock and play around with.

I hope you have a good time with the SLOTS & DAGGERS demo <3

Cheers, 
Friedemann
